BackendTimeout.x-description: The request timed out while waiting for a backend response; the backend outcome may be ambiguous.

BackendUnavailable.x-description: The gateway could not reach a required backend such as hogd, the scheduler, or the indexer.

BlockNotFound.x-description: The requested block height is out of range or beyond the current indexed chain tip.

InvalidParams.x-description: One or more JSON-RPC parameters are malformed, out of range, or otherwise invalid.

TxHash.description:
Canonical transaction hash: `sha256(xdr_serialize(signed_tx.tx))`.
Covers the inner Transaction body (not signatures), matching
the scheduler's lookup key and the indexer's primary key.

Serializes as `"0x..."` hex string (64 hex chars).

x-data-schema.description:
Retained transaction evidence returned when local funding cannot resolve an outcome.
This does not prove admission or execution. Reconcile this hash and reuse the original request.

signedTransaction.description: Exact signed bytes persisted before the first submission.

txHash.description: Canonical hash of the retained transaction body.

x-data-schema.title: LocalFundingErrorData

LocalFundingUnresolved.x-description: Local funding retained a signed transaction but could not resolve its outcome. Data contains its transaction hash and exact signed bytes, not proof of admission or execution. Reconcile that hash and retry the original request; do not create a replacement transfer.

NotImplemented.x-description: The JSON-RPC method exists but is not implemented by this gateway or backend capability shape.

Overloaded.x-description: The gateway or backend is overloaded and rejected the request before it reached side-effecting backend execution.

x-data-schema.description:
Machine-readable detail carried in the `data` field of a `TxInvalid`
error raised by pre-submission bound checks.

`reason` discriminates the variant; the remaining fields are the
numbers a client needs to repair the transaction, which the error
`message` restates in prose. A `TxInvalid` error without `data` had no
structured detail to offer (for example, undecodable XDR).

These checks are advisory: they mirror what the executor rejects
deterministically before running a transaction, so a rejection here
saves a round trip, but passing them does not guarantee acceptance.

oneOf.description:
`contractsToDeploy` attaches more contracts than the chain permits

x-data-schema.title: TxInvalidDetail

TxInvalid.x-description: The submitted transaction is malformed, has invalid XDR, or fails local validation before backend submission. When the rejection comes from a pre-submission bound check, `data` carries a `TxInvalidDetail` object whose `reason` names the violated bound.

TxNotFound.x-description: The requested transaction hash was not found in the mempool or committed index.

TxRejected.x-description: The submitted transaction is well-formed but was rejected by the scheduler or execution backend.

ConflictCode.description:
Reason a storage delta could not be applied during two-phase commit.
Projects hogd's `DbConflictCode`.

New codes may be added as hogd evolves; unrecognized codes surface
as `Other` on both serialize and deserialize so mixed-version
deployments degrade instead of failing.

oneOf.description:
The key is exclusively locked by another transaction, an
exclusive lock could not be acquired, or an exclusive-lock flag
was used on a key type that does not support it.
Two transactions created different item types at the same key.

Two transactions wrote irreconcilable values of the same type at
the same key.

A nonnegative int (or balance) would go below zero given the
deltas in this block, or a newly created balance item cannot
cover its own storage cost.
Integer overflow combining deltas on a nonnegative int or balance.

Replay-protection conflict: uniquifier expired, already consumed,
or consumed twice by this transaction.
A retrocausal queue already has a consumer in this block.
A per-item capacity limit was hit.

The native HOG balance at the diagnostic's address cannot cover the
debits in this block, or a newly created balance item cannot cover
its own storage cost. Storage written under a contract's address is
charged to that contract's balance, so a deployment reports this at

Unrecognized conflict code. Check for gateway updates.

ConflictDiagnostic.description: One conflicting storage operation reported by two-phase commit.

address.description: Contract whose storage the conflicting operation targeted.

ContractAddressList.description: Contract addresses accepted by a single event filter. Mirrors the hogd-indexer per-filter contract-address bound.

ContractRejectCode.description: Reason the executor refused a contract attachment.

oneOf.description: Unrecognized rejection code from a newer node.

DecimalBlockHeight.description: Canonical decimal integer in the inclusive range -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807.

DecimalTimePoint.description: Canonical decimal integer in the inclusive range 0 to 18446744073709551615.

DecimalU64.description: Canonical decimal integer in the inclusive range 0 to 18446744073709551615.

EmittedEvent.description:
A single emitted event, as stored by the hogd indexer.

The gateway parses hogd's `TxEmittedEvent.serialized_event` into
separate topics and data. The serialized format is:
`topic0 (32B) || topic1 (32B) || ... || data (remaining bytes)`.
`num_topics` (0–3) determines the split point. Max total 1024 bytes.

See `docs/gateway/system-design.md` "Event Parsing" for details.

data.description: Opaque event data (up to 1KB, contract-defined encoding).

topics.description:
Up to 3 topics per event, each exactly 32 bytes
(indexed, filterable in Phase 4).

EventFilter.description:
A single event-filter predicate: events must be emitted by one of
`contractAddresses` AND match the topic constraints. Required
non-empty `contractAddresses` — the indexer has no topic-indexed
column family and can't efficiently serve "any contract" scans.
(When such an index is added, the gateway relaxes the non-empty
check; the wire contract stays the same.)

EventFilterList.description: Event filters accepted by a single event query. Mirrors the hogd-indexer per-query filter bound.

EventPage.description:
One page of events returned by `getEvents`.

Opaque cursors continue one historical walk; an empty cursor ends it.
For restart rules, see the
[pagination contract](https://docs.groundhog.dev/reference/json-rpc-api/#pagination-contract).

cursor.description:
Empty when the stream has been exhausted in the requested
direction.  Non-empty: pass back in the next call's `cursor`
argument.

events.description:
Matched events in the requested order.  May be empty even when
`cursor` is non-empty: the filter was selective and the current
scan window produced no matches; client should keep paginating.
Empty events + empty cursor = stream exhausted.

latestBlock.description: Highest block height indexed at response time, not an application checkpoint.

oldestBlock.description:
Oldest block height the indexer still retains data for at
response time.  Today always 0; meaningful once retention/
pruning lands.

EventQuery.description:
`getEvents` request. A candidate event matches the query iff it
matches at least one `EventFilter` in `filters` (OR across filters,
AND within each filter).

cursor.description:
`0x` on the initial call. Non-empty to continue where a previous
response left off. `order` and `anchor` remain required request fields,
but the cursor supplies continuation state. Keep the same filters.
A cursor continues one historical walk, not blocks added after it began.

filters.description: At least one filter is required. Empty lists are not all-contract scans.

limit.description:
Values above the server's per-page cap (default 200) are
rejected as invalid params; `0` means server default (50).

EventTopicFilter.description:
Positional topic filter. For each topic position (0, 1, 2):
  - An empty list means "match anything at this position."
  - A non-empty list means "match if the event's topic at this
    position is in this list." OR within a position, AND across
    positions.

Partial match: a filter that specifies only topic0 matches events
with more topics. Extra topics on the event past the filter's
specified positions are ignored. (This is the ethereum getLogs /
stellar-rpc post-#358 semantics.)

ExecStatus.description:
Execution result. Maps to hogd's `ExecResult` variants.
Richer than EVM's binary status (0 = fail, 1 = success).

New variants may be added as hogd's `ExecResult` evolves.
Clients should handle unknown variants gracefully.

oneOf.description: Transaction executed successfully.
Root call frame reverted (contract called abort/revert).

message.description: Abort buffer from the contract, if any.

oneOf.description:
Deterministic execution error: the transaction faulted during
execution (out-of-bounds access, out of gas, stack overflow, etc.).

kind.description:
Error kind from the execution engine. `"fault"` when the
node does not report a finer-grained category (currently
always — see `DETERMINISTIC_ERROR_KIND_FAULT`).

oneOf.description: Commit failed due to a race or other proposal-time storage conflict.
Gas sponsorship failed.

Unrecognized execution result from the indexer.
Returned when the gateway encounters an `ExecResult` variant
it doesn't know about. Check for gateway updates.

Rules fetched during this request, without stale-cache fallback.
Apply to execution following `observedTip`; later inclusion can use newer rules.

configHash.description: Consensus commitment to the stated configuration and storage model.

effectiveLimits.description: Runtime-resolved limits; omissions are unavailable, never zero.

observedTip.description: Committed snapshot read together with these rules.

storageCosts.description: Active storage collateral schedule in native-HOG base units.

faucet.description: Expected random faucet identity; refuses a different chain at the same URL.

signedTransaction.description: Signed transaction retained before its first broadcast.

The execution parameters a chain's network config states, flattened

A field is `None`, and absent from the JSON, when the config does not
state that parameter; the node alone decides what is then in force.

Request bounds this JSON-RPC endpoint enforces. Returned by
`serverLimits`.

These are operator settings local to the serving endpoint, not consensus
parameters: two endpoints for the same chain may report different values,
and a value may change when the endpoint is reconfigured. Consensus-checked

maxCursorBytes.description: Longest opaque pagination cursor accepted, in bytes.

Largest `gasLimit` a `view` request may ask for, and the budget a view
runs under when it names none.

StorageCosts.description:
Integer native-HOG base units (10,000,000 per HOG), encoded as decimal strings.
Storage collateral is separate from gas capacity. A first credit pays the
recipient's balance deposit; code storage is charged to the deployed address.

authPerKeyCost.description: Added to the ordinary base for each authorization key.

balanceCost.description: Entire balance-item deposit, deducted once from the first credit (no ordinary base).

baseContractDeploymentCost.description: RV32 deployment base; does not include the new address's balance deposit.

baseDataItemCost.description: Base charge for an ordinary data item; balance and deployment have separate bases.

bytestringCostPerByte.description: Added to the ordinary base for each byte of a bytestring value (u32).

contractDeploymentCostPerByte.description: Added per byte of ContractBlob.data, including the full RV32 artifact.

rcqCostPerEntry.description: Added to the ordinary base per live queue entry; an empty queue costs zero.

replayCacheCostPerEntry.description: Added to the ordinary base per replay-cache entry, charged to its owner.

StorageItemInfo.description:
Latest-committed value at a single storage location, presented as
a tagged union so machine consumers can switch on `kind` without
running an XDR codec for the common cases.

oneOf.description:
Non-negative int128 (e.g., HOG balance).  Encoded as a
decimal string because i128 exceeds JSON-number precision.
Raw byte array stored at this key.

Authorization data is registered at this address.  Presence
indicator only; `getAddressAuthData` returns the signer set.

A retrocausal queue is registered at this address.  Presence
indicator only — RCQ data is not held in a single storage
item, and per-item structure here would be misleading.
Wallets that need to interpret RCQ contents invoke a
contract that exposes them.

Replay-cache entry exists at this key.  No payload — the
presence is the signal.
Deployed contract metadata.

hash.description: Hash of the deployed contract bytecode.

oneOf.description:
Storage variant unknown to this client.  Indicates the
protocol shipped a new variant that this build was not
regenerated against — clients should treat as
"uninterpretable" and fall back to alternative reads.

typeId.description: Raw protocol type id of the unrecognized variant.

StorageItemRead.description:
Outcome of reading one storage location at the latest committed
snapshot.  `block_height` is always set to the snapshot the read
was performed against, even when no item exists at the requested
key — that lets callers compare against `chainTip` to gauge
freshness.

blockHeight.description: Committed block height the snapshot was read at.

item.description:
The item stored at the requested key, or `null` if the key
has no committed value at this snapshot.

TopicList.description: Topic values accepted for a single topic position. This is an RPC-layer cap, not a hogd-indexer protocol constant.

TransactionFailureCause.description: Why a recent proposal attempt failed. This diagnostic is advisory, not final.

oneOf.description: Two-phase commit could not apply a storage delta.
The executor refused a contract attachment before execution.

contractIndex.description: Position in the transaction's contracts-to-deploy list.

oneOf.description: A cause added by a newer server.

TransactionReceipt.description:
Full transaction receipt. Returned by `getTransactionReceipt`.

Design notes:
- `status` maps from `TxEventLog.exec_result` in the indexer.
  Committed blocks include both successful and deterministically-failed
  txs (reverts, OOG). If a receipt exists, the tx was committed.
- No `blockHash`: SCP instant finality, height is sufficient.
- No `gasPrice`, `transactionIndex`, `logsBloom`.
- `gasUsed` is committed by consensus as part of the transaction's event
  log (`TxEventLog.gas_consumed`).

`storage_delta` (net HOG locked/unlocked) is deferred — hogd's
`TxInfo` doesn't include it. Will be added when indexer support lands.

abortData.description:
Bytes the contract passed to its `abort` / `revert` syscall
when the transaction reverted deterministically.  Present
when `status` is `reverted` and the chain version that
executed the transaction recorded the revert payload; absent
otherwise.  Returned raw — decode against the contract's
spec (typically the error variant) to recover a human-
readable reason.

gasUsed.description:
Gas the transaction consumed: the root frame, every frame it invoked,
and the pre-execution validation of attached contracts. On an
out-of-gas fault it equals the transaction's gas limit.

Committed by consensus as part of the event log, so every node
reports the same figure.

height.description: Block height at which this transaction was committed.

returnData.description:
Bytes returned by the contract's root call on a successful
transaction.  Present when `status` is `ok` and the chain
version that executed the transaction recorded a return
value; absent otherwise.  Returned raw — decode against the
contract's spec to recover typed values.

TransactionRef.description:
Lightweight reference to a transaction: its hash plus the block it
executed in.  Hydrate the full body via `getTransactionReceipt`.

TransactionRefPage.description:
`getTransactionsByAddress` response: transaction refs in the
requested order.

Opaque cursors continue one historical walk; an empty cursor ends it.
For restart rules, see the
[pagination contract](https://docs.groundhog.dev/reference/json-rpc-api/#pagination-contract).

cursor.description:
Empty when the stream has been exhausted in the requested
direction.  Non-empty: pass back in the next call's `cursor`
argument.

latestBlock.description: Highest block height indexed at response time, not an application checkpoint.

oldestBlock.description:
Oldest block height the indexer still retains data for at
response time.

refs.description:
Matched transaction refs in the requested order.  Empty refs +
empty cursor = stream exhausted.

TransactionStatus.description:
Lightweight transaction status from the mempool and indexer.

Pending reports mempool presence; Committed reports scheduler success or an indexed record.
See `docs/gateway/system-design.md` "Transaction Status Lookup Order" for
degraded-mode behavior when a backend is unavailable.

New variants may be added in future phases.

oneOf.description: In the mempool, not yet in a committed block.

Included in a committed block. SCP finality = done.
No `block_hash`: SCP instant finality means no forks/reorgs,
so height alone is sufficient for confirmation.

height.description: Committed block height supplied by the scheduler or indexer.

oneOf.description: Scheduler rejected the transaction.

No committed record, but a recent proposal attempt failed and the
indexer still holds its diagnostic. This includes storage conflicts
during two-phase commit and contract attachments refused before execution.

Best-effort and advisory: reports are dropped freely under load,
only the proposing node's indexers hear them, and a later retry
of the same transaction may still commit (at which point
`Committed` wins). Absence of this status proves nothing.

attemptHeight.description: Executing block height of the failed attempt.

cause.description: First storage conflict or refused contract attachment.

oneOf.description: Scheduler processing failed; resubmitting the transaction may succeed.
Scheduler processing failed permanently; modify the transaction before resubmitting.
Not found in the scheduler's retained outcomes or indexer.

Unrecognized status from a newer server. Returned when the
client encounters a `status` tag it doesn't know about. Check
for client updates.

TxHash.description:
Canonical transaction hash: `sha256(xdr_serialize(signed_tx.tx))`.
Covers the inner Transaction body (not signatures), matching
the scheduler's lookup key and the indexer's primary key.

Serializes as `"0x..."` hex string (64 hex chars).

VersionInfo.description: Runtime version information for a JSON-RPC server implementation.

bundleManifestDigest.description:
Digest of the validated installed bundle manifest, when release identity is available.
Consumers must not branch on this field.

commitHash.description:
Diagnostic-only Git commit hash this server was built from, when available.
Consumers must not branch on this field.

implementation.description:
Diagnostic-only implementation version of the binary serving this RPC endpoint.
Consumers must not branch on this field.

platformVersion.description:
Platform release this binary was packaged for, when available.
Consumers must not branch on this field.

releaseVersion.description:
Release containing this binary, after validation against its installed bundle manifest.
Consumers must not branch on this field.

wireFormat.description: Wire-format `SemVer` of the `OpenRPC` spec this node implements.

ViewRequest.description: Request for sandboxed contract simulation against the latest committed state.

caller.description: Optional simulated caller address observed by `get_msg_sender`.

entrypoint.description: Contract entrypoint id. Must be exactly 8 bytes.

gasLimit.description:
Optional gas budget for the root invocation. Absent selects the
server's `maxViewGas` (see `serverLimits`); a value above it, or zero,
is rejected as an invalid parameter. No gas is charged for a view.

events.description:
Events emitted during view execution.

Hogd captures emitted events from the simulated frame; wallet-preview
callers see what events a real submit would produce.

gasUsed.description:
Gas the invocation consumed: the root frame and every frame it
invoked. On an out-of-gas fault it equals the gas limit the view ran
with. Matches the `gasUsed` a transaction with no attached contracts
making the same invocation would report; out-of-gas is checked
strictly, so size a transaction's limit above this figure.

height.description: Block height of the committed snapshot used for the view.

methods.name: groundhog_sendRawTransaction
methods.summary: Submit a signed transaction (0x-prefixed hex XDR). Returns the canonical tx hash. Transactions whose `blockExpiryHeight` is at or below the current chain tip can never commit and are rejected with `TxRejected` when the tip is available. Transactions that break an executor pre-execution bound (too many attached contracts for the chain config, an oversized contract, an RV32 artifact declaring more guest memory or code than the chain admits, or a duplicate attachment) are rejected with `TxInvalid` carrying a `TxInvalidDetail` in the error `data`.

methods.name: groundhog_getTransactionReceipt
methods.summary: Full receipt for a committed transaction.

methods.name: groundhog_getTransactionStatus
methods.summary: Lightweight status check. Indexed commitment takes priority. Otherwise, return the scheduler's pending, committed, retry, or dropped outcome; an advisory indexer failure is returned only after a scheduler miss. Scheduler and indexed commitments include the actual block height, including block zero. `unknown` requires successful misses from both backends; failed lookups must not be interpreted as absence.

methods.name: groundhog_chainTip
methods.summary: Current chain tip: height, block hash, and the protocol it executed under.

methods.name: groundhog_chainConfig
methods.summary: Stated execution parameters, plus an authoritative `execution` reading when supported. Top-level omissions mean unspecified. `execution` pairs resolved limits and storage prices with the committed tip observed during this request; it is never served from a stale cache. Stated fields come from the same fresh DB reading. Unavailable or unreadable readings fail with `BackendUnavailable`.

methods.name: groundhog_serverLimits
methods.summary: Request bounds this endpoint enforces, such as the `view` gas ceiling. These are local operator settings, not consensus parameters: they can differ between endpoints serving the same chain. Answered without contacting a backend.

methods.name: groundhog_networkInfo
methods.summary: Immutable protocol and genesis identity of the network this endpoint serves.

methods.name: groundhog_getBlockByNumber
methods.summary: Block data at a given height.

methods.name: groundhog_pendingTransactionCount
methods.summary: Number of transactions in the mempool.

methods.name: groundhog_getEvents
methods.summary: Paginated, filterable contract events. See `EventQuery` / `EventPage` for the Soroban-shaped filter / cursor / topic surface, with RPC-native `0x`-prefixed address and topic projections at the JSON boundary.

methods.name: groundhog_getTransactionsByAddress
methods.summary: Paginated transaction history for a single address: refs to transactions whose root invocation targets the address, walked in the requested order. Hydrate full bodies via `getTransactionReceipt`.

methods.name: groundhog_getStorageAt
methods.summary: Read the latest committed storage item at an address/key pair. `block_height` in the returned `StorageItemRead` always reflects the snapshot the read was performed against — even when no item is present at the key — so wallets can compare against `chainTip` to gauge freshness.

methods.name: groundhog_getBalance
methods.summary: Native HOG balance for any address at the latest committed snapshot.

methods.name: groundhog_getAddressAuthData
methods.summary: Authorization configuration (signer keys, their weights, and the required weight) registered at any address, at the latest committed snapshot. `authData` is `null` when the address has none; such an address accepts only pubkey-signature claims, and one with auth data only source-address claims.

methods.name: groundhog_view
methods.summary: Execute a sandboxed contract simulation against the latest committed state. There is no way to select a past height; `height` in the response names the snapshot the view ran against. `gasLimit` is optional: absent runs under the endpoint's `maxViewGas` (see `serverLimits`); zero or a value above it is rejected as an invalid parameter.

methods.name: groundhog_version
methods.summary: Version dimensions for this JSON-RPC server.

methods.name: groundhog_requestAirdrop
methods.summary: Request an idempotent native HOG airdrop.  Servers register this method only when an airdrop backend is configured; other deployments return standard JSON-RPC `Method not found`.

methods.name: groundhog_fundAccount
methods.summary: Submit an explicit native HOG transfer using a retained caller nonce.  Acceptance does not imply execution success. Observe the returned hash through the ordinary status/receipt APIs. Retry an uncertain response with exactly the same request; retain its chain identity and amount. Hosted servers return standard JSON-RPC `Method not found`.
